decision: Source10 belt depth and long-coat weights need correction; unmodified head/glove/foot models remain reusable

reviews.notes: Casual jacket and winter coat/waistcoat distinct; continuous trousers and covered cuffs, no former hip/coat intersections in front.
Country summer/mid-season fronts: continuous looser trousers, sash and regional hat; cuffs/gloves and shoes attached.
RW rear drape coherent, but front belt buckle protrudes through poncho after the shared lower-torso expansion. Correct only the covered RW belt depth before delivery.
Poor summer/mid-season fronts: retained patch materials fitted to continuous trousers; ungloved hands and worn shoes visible, no detached patches.
Poor winter front/rear: patched long coat, fitted leg patches and gloves, full back coverage; continuous trousers remain inside coat.

Casual jacket profile remains connected; poncho profile has intentional open sides with long shirt sleeves. Shared lower-torso scaling overextends only the RW belt/buckle, now isolated for correction.

Rejected coat weights: long warm formal coat folds around knees with severe self-intersection; shorter winter coat also distorts. Constrain torso garments and their attached details to a continuous torso/thigh field, excluding nearby hands and shins.
